overview_description.description: Pulppo is the first Tech Enabled broker for Latin America. We partner with the best brokers in the region and empower them with tools, technology and resources to create a simple and transparent buying process. Pulppo was founded by Agustin Iglesias, former GM of Inmuebles24 and founder of Tokko Broker (Acquired by Navent) and Matias Gath, former GM of Glovo in Argentina and founder of Kadabra (acquired by Glovo).

about_short_description.short_description: Pulppo is the first Proptech that created a transparent and seamless buying process by empowering agents with tech, tools and support.

product.name: CRM Linked to WhatsApp
product.description: A customer relationship management tool integrated with WhatsApp to facilitate client follow-up and automate messaging.

product.name: Valuation Tool
product.description: A tool that provides quick property value opinions using comparative market analysis.

product.name: Marketing with Leads
product.description: A service that coordinates digital marketing campaigns to generate high-potential real estate leads.

product.name: Legal Support
product.description: Specialized legal assistance for real estate transactions to expedite and protect sales processes.

product.name: All-in-One Platform
product.description: A consolidated platform that integrates various technological tools to manage daily real estate tasks.

product.name: Continuous Training
product.description: Ongoing training programs within a collaborative community to improve sales, customer service, and content creation skills.
